name: REMORA
source:
TW:  homophobia, violence, history and  explicit discussion of csa flashbacks, suicide, SW

> a remora has a seemingly parasitic but truthfully symbiotic relationship to the host it latches onto

> a visual novel about imagining a love as sweet as a peach blossom kiss. (and as bitter as fairy foxglove, too.)

the theme of REMORA and all my games is to humanize the extremity, severity, and atrocity that it takes to create a sociopath, who was once a child whose humanity was shattered in the cradle

and to show what love/obsession/devotion looks like

[From [url=https://swanchime.itch.io/remora]itch.io[/url]]
